resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says Bath County; the Forest Lookouts list says Bath / Rockbridge. The story follows the register.

The register's White Rock Tower Site (US 1706, VA 13) is described as atop Mill Mountain, but its coordinates lie well south and west of the Mill Mountain Tower Site (US 1708, VA 15). The Forest Lookouts list cross-references Mill Mountain to White Rock. The story keeps the two register records separate and says the sources do not settle whether they are the same mountain site.

corrections.proposed: No shared register number found: Mill Mountain is US 1708, VA 15; White Rock is US 1706, VA 13.
corrections.why: The two register detail pages give different numbers, so the brief's note is not supported.

notes_for_editor: Identity is the main open question. By coordinates, the register's Mill Mountain site (38.08 N, 79.49 W) and its White Rock site on Mill Mountain (37.84 N, 79.69 W, Rich Hole Wilderness) are far apart, but the Forest Lookouts list treats them as one name. A Forest Service or Bath County history source on the Mill Mountain tower location would settle it. No staffing, fire or access data found. The Forest Service trail belongs to the White Rock site, not confirmed for the register's Mill Mountain site. A Roanoke Mill Mountain observation tower also exists (search snippet only, not read); it is a different structure and should not be confused with this record.
